description: Four people ask for more trams to the east side and merge. A minority keeps a condition and stays on its own, as does an opposing view and a unique idea.

inputs.statement: More trams should run to the east side of the city.

evidence.quote: we need more trams to the east side

inputs.statement: The east side of the city needs more frequent trams.

evidence.quote: the east side needs trams more often

inputs.statement: There should be more trams going to the east of the city.

evidence.quote: put on more trams going east

inputs.statement: Trams to the east side should run more often.

evidence.quote: trams to the east should just run more often

inputs.statement: More trams should run to the east side, but only if the existing bus lines are kept.

evidence.quote: more trams is fine, but only if they keep our bus lines

inputs.statement: The old tram depot should become a public market hall.

evidence.quote: turn the old depot into a market hall

inputs.statement: More trams are the wrong answer for the east side; it needs a metro line.

evidence.quote: trams are the wrong answer, the east needs a metro

should_merge.why: All four ask for more trams to the east side. mi2 and mi4 ask for trams more often, mi1 and mi3 for more trams; keeping quantity apart from frequency is also acceptable.

must_not_merge.why: The minority adds a condition: only if bus lines stay.
